author: smuzaffar
body:
[RecoTrackerLSTCore-standalone-compilation](https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/logreader/el9_amd64_gcc16/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-19-2300/unitTestLogs/RecoTracker/LSTCore#/) unit test fail for GCC16 with error [a]. This PR proposes to add the missing header `cstdint` for `uint8_t`

[a]
```
In file included from cxxopts.cc:1:
cxxopts.h:53:5: error: 'uint8_t' does not name a type
   53 |     uint8_t major, minor, patch;
      |     ^~~~~~~
cxxopts.h:40:1: note: 'uint8_t' is defined in header '<cstdint>'; this is probably fixable by adding '#include <cstdint>'
   39 | #include <vector>
  +++ |+#include <cstdint>
   40 | #include <limits>
cxxopts.h:54:86: error: too many initializers for 'const cxxopts::<unnamed struct>'
   54 |   } version = {CXXOPTS__VERSION_MAJOR, CXXOPTS__VERSION_MINOR, CXXOPTS__VERSION_PATCH};
      |                                                                                      ^
cxxopts.h: In function 'void cxxopts::values::integer_parser(const std::string&, T&)':
cxxopts.h:358:13: error: 'uint8_t' does not name a type [-Wtemplate-body]
  358 |       const uint8_t base = match.length(2) > 0 ? 16 : 10;
```
title: [gcc16][LSTCore/standalone]: Added missing header for uint8_t
